description: This file defines the 'Report' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_report' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties for report attributes such as ID, name, report group, filter usage, and type, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Entity class representing a report in the HRM system, with properties for report metadata and ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report.

methods.name: isUseFilterField
methods.description: Checks if filter field usage is enabled for this report.

methods.name: setUseFilterField
methods.description: Enables or disables filter field usage.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the report, if specified.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the report.
